text: The wannabe steps off the 6670 bus at 水社. Walks past 水社遊客中心, sees the 捷安特 sign. No queue. Walks right in. Picks an e-bike. The day starts perfectly.

text: First km on 月潭自行車道 — the elevated water platform. Lake on the left, mountains ahead, wind in their face. This is the Instagram reel come alive. No other cyclists blocking the shot.

text: 向山遊客中心 — the architecture is stunning, the cantilever platform juts over the lake. Coffee in hand. Decision: continue east to 伊達邵? At 8K visitors, of course. The road ahead is clear.

text: 伊達邵商店街 — 山豬肉香腸 sizzling, 小米麻糬 bouncing in the fryer. The wannabe locks the bike, joins the food stalls. No crowd crush. They find a seat, eat slowly. The lake glitters through the buildings.

text: Lunch done. The bike is at 伊達邵. Home base is 捷安特 水社. In the dream day, this is fine — the 8km return ride is pleasant. Quiet road, afternoon light on the water. The wannabe climbs back on and rides north. An hour of gentle pedaling, not a slog.

text: The wannabe is back at 水社, bike returned. Walks to 水社碼頭. Takes the 15:00 ferry for a lazy sunset circuit — 水社→玄光→伊達邵→水社. Golden hour on the water. The cherry on top of a perfect day.

text: Back at 水社碼頭, sunset painting the mountains. The wannabe walks past the rental station (closed for the day) and catches the 17:00 bus back to 台中. Instagram story posted: 日月潭 is as good as promised. 5 stars. Would cycle again.
